description: Search public, predominantly Polish-language msza.ai sermons plus sermon studies, Bible passages, prayers, songs, people, and places for focused topic, keyword, or relevance discovery. Returned source text stays in its stored language. Use it only when no exact ID or dedicated lookup applies; do not invoke it for a generic faith or prayer conversation without a request to discover msza.ai material, and do not invoke it automatically for every request. For a non-Polish topic, use one focused Polish query while preserving proper names, IDs, Bible references, and date, church, and content filters. Do not fan out translation variants; after an empty or weak topic result, use at most one useful Polish rephrase with the same constraints. Use days_back for rolling periods and date_from/date_to for any absolute historical period. Missing results do not prove absence. Returned hits are candidates: a query may match other session content, so verify selected sermon text and do not treat retrieval.topicMatch as evidence for every result. Returns source IDs, stable citation labels, short excerpts, dates, and links. Priest names are not stored.

camera_id.description: Optional stable church profile ID. When supplied, only public sermons from that church are searched.

content_types.description: Optional content categories to search; omitted preserves automatic mixed discovery. Unselected categories are not queried. prayer_book covers prayers, songs and fixed liturgical texts. ai_study results are AI-generated orientation, not evidence. Explicit bible selection enables bounded Scripture search without intent inference. Date/weekday/church filters apply only to sermons; camera_id requires sermon when content_types is supplied. Up to 6 entries; duplicates are removed. Existing source kind labels remain unchanged.

date_from.description: Optional first Warsaw calendar day of an absolute archive period, inclusive.

date_to.description: Optional last Warsaw calendar day of an absolute archive period, inclusive.

days_back.description: Optional rolling calendar-day window ending today, for example 7 or 28. Omit when using date_from or date_to.

limit.description: Maximum number of compact source results to return.

query.description: Focused Polish retrieval query for a topical request. For another user language, translate only topical terms into Polish while preserving proper names, exact IDs, Bible references, and supplied filters.

weekday.description: Optional Warsaw weekday filter: Sunday=0, Monday=1, ..., Saturday=6.

name: search_msza_ai

content_types.description: Normalized requested categories, present only when explicitly supplied.

prayer_id.description: Exact get_prayer argument for a prayer-book search result.

study_id.description: Exact get_ai_study argument for an AI-generated study result.

title: Search public msza.ai sources
